request.title: Reading brief
request.purpose: Create a short internal briefing from public-domain research articles, with analyst source checks.
request.tool: ExampleAI Digest, a fictional hosted tool; approved for the stated public-only use in this synthetic scenario.
request.users: Two named internal analysts; no external audience.
request.affected_people: Internal analysts only; no decisions about people or operational actions.
request.input_sources: Public-domain research reports selected by an analyst.
request.data_categories: Public-domain text; no personal, confidential, or privileged information.
request.confidentiality: Public only; no personal or privileged data.
request.outputs: An internal digest with links to the source reports.
request.output_use: Background reading; no financial, legal, employment, or safety decisions.
request.autonomy: Read-only drafting; no integrations, decisions, or actions.
request.human_review: A named analyst checks every summary against the sources before sharing.
